prioritized_gaps.source_problem: Cho hình chóp S.ABCD có đáy là hình vuông cạnh a, SA ⊥ (ABCD) và SB tạo với đáy một góc 60°.
prioritized_gaps.expected_mathematical_behavior: Derive apex height `SA = AB * tan(60°) = a√3` from line-plane angle `(SB, (ABCD)) = ∠SBA = 60°` when `A` is the orthogonal projection of `S` onto `(ABCD)`.
prioritized_gaps.actual_failure: Local Parser returns `LOCAL_PARSE_PARTIAL` (`unparsed_AngleClause`); `Registry /33` has `ask_angle_line_plane` as a goal query (`bac = 0`), not an inverse height-fixing premise.
prioritized_gaps.responsible_layer: Local Geometry Parser + TypedFactNext /2 Premise Schema + Registry /33 + Engine /24
prioritized_gaps.correctness_risk: MEDIUM — must verify `foot(S, base) = A` before identifying `∠(SB, base) = ∠SBA` and restrict to exact constructible angles `{30°, 45°, 60°}`.
prioritized_gaps.estimated_performance_impact: NEGLIGIBLE (`< 0.2 ms` exact `Radical` arithmetic, `0 MB` RAM).

prioritized_gaps.source_problem: Đáy ABCD là hình thang vuông tại A và B (hoặc hình thang với AD // BC, AD = 2BC); đáy ABC là tam giác cân tại C.
prioritized_gaps.expected_mathematical_behavior: Place 4-vertex right/isosceles trapezoid or isosceles triangle base in exact `Fraction`/`Radical` 2D chart coordinates and certify parallel/perpendicular sides in `kiem_khang_dinh_loai_hinh`.
prioritized_gaps.actual_failure: Refused fail-closed (`MISSING_DIMENSION` / `LOCAL_PARSE_PARTIAL`) because `engine.py` base chart templates cover square, rectangle, right/equilateral triangle, and 3-side Heron triangle, but not `right_trapezoid` or `isosceles_trapezoid`.
prioritized_gaps.responsible_layer: TypedFactNext /2 + Source Gate (`registry.py`) + Exact Kernel (`engine.py` base layout)
prioritized_gaps.correctness_risk: LOW-MEDIUM — vertex ordering (`AD // BC` vs `AB // CD`) and convexity orientation must be certified in `kiem_khang_dinh_loai_hinh`.

prioritized_gaps.source_problem: Đáy ABC có AB = 5, AC = 6, Â = 60° (hoặc đáy ABCD là hình thoi cạnh a, góc BAD = 60°).
prioritized_gaps.expected_mathematical_behavior: Place general triangle with `∠BAC ∈ {30°, 45°, 60°, 120°, 135°, 150°}` via Law of Cosines or rhombus `(AB=BC=CD=DA, ∠BAD=60°)` in `(1, √3)` radical chart.
prioritized_gaps.actual_failure: Local Parser stops at `Â = 60°` / `hình bình hành`; `engine.py` lacks 2-side + included-angle and rhombus `60°/120°` base builders.
prioritized_gaps.responsible_layer: Local Geometry Parser + Registry /33 + Exact Kernel (`engine.py`)
prioritized_gaps.correctness_risk: LOW — exact `cos(60°) = 1/2`, `sin(60°) = √3/2` stays within single-square-root `Radical(a, 3)` domain.

prioritized_gaps.source_problem: Khoảng cách từ điểm A đến đường thẳng đi qua B và trung điểm của SC (`@m1` inside `line` operand).
prioritized_gaps.expected_mathematical_behavior: Lower `line=[B, @m1]` in `bridge_v2` by materializing `midpoint(S, C) -> _M1` before `ask_distance_point_line(A, B, _M1)`.
prioritized_gaps.responsible_layer: Bridge v2 (`typed_fact_next_bridge.py`) + Source Gate `effect-chain` span verifier
prioritized_gaps.correctness_risk: LOW-MEDIUM — must preserve verbatim quote ownership in `Source Gate`.

prioritized_gaps.source_problem: Khoảng cách giữa trung điểm của SA và trung điểm của BC (`@m1` and `@n1` in one `distance` goal).
prioritized_gaps.expected_mathematical_behavior: Materialize both `@m1` and `@n1` in topological order and compute exact segment length `|_M1 _N1|`.

next_wave_implementation_design_trapezoi.scope: Design specification only (per Section X: no mass implementation in this wave).

1_right_and_isosceles_trapezoid_design.contract: Extend `PremiseSpec` / `Registry` with `right_trapezoid_base(vertices=[A,B,C,D], parallel_bases=[AD,BC], right_vertices=[A,B])` and `isosceles_trapezoid_base(vertices=[A,B,C,D], parallel_bases=[AD,BC])`.
1_right_and_isosceles_trapezoid_design.coordinate_chart: Place `A=(0,0,0)`, `B=(0,h,0)` (`h = AB`), `D=(ad,0,0)`, `C=(bc,h,0)` for right trapezoid (`AD // BC`, `∠DAB = ∠ABC = 90°`), requiring exact `AB, AD, BC` (or `CD` via `h² = CD² - (AD - BC)²` certified square-free radical). For isosceles trapezoid (`AD // BC`, `AB = CD`), set `A=(0,0,0)`, `D=(ad,0,0)`, `B=((ad-bc)/2, h, 0)`, `C=((ad+bc)/2, h, 0)` with `h = √(AB² - ((ad-bc)/2)²)`.
1_right_and_isosceles_trapezoid_design.source_gate_invariants: Require explicit parallel-base clause (`đáy lớn / đáy nhỏ` or `AD // BC`) plus right-angle vertices (`vuông tại A và B`) in verbatim quote; refuse `PLANE_NOT_UNIQUE` / `MISSING_DIMENSION` if parallel pair is unspecified.

2_rhombus_60_120_design.contract: Add `rhombus_base_with_angle(vertices=[A,B,C,D], side=a, vertex=A, angle_deg=60|120)` (or diagonal lengths `AC, BD`).
2_rhombus_60_120_design.coordinate_chart: For `∠BAD = 60°` and side `a`: `A=(0,0,0)`, `B=(a,0,0)`, `D=(a/2, a√3/2, 0)`, `C=(3a/2, a√3/2, 0)` in exact `Radical(Fraction, 3)` coordinates; for `∠BAD = 120°`, swap `60° <-> 120°` (`D=(-a/2, a√3/2, 0)`). Certify `|AB|²=|BC|²=|CD|²=|DA|²=a²` and `cos²(∠BAD) ∈ {1/4}` in `kiem_khang_dinh_loai_hinh`.
2_rhombus_60_120_design.source_gate_invariants: Match `đáy ABCD là hình thoi cạnh <val>, góc <V> bằng 60°|120°` (or `tam giác ABC đều`) without guessing acute vs obtuse vertex when angle vertex is unnamed (`AMBIGUOUS_FACT`).
